messages:
maria: quick sync — we need a short, actionable checklist for production clearance of the Realtime API this week. pulling in ops/docs/finance. main gaps i want us to confirm: SLA floors, runbook coverage, telemetry gating, pricing/tier approval, and support handoff. who can own each item?

arjun: i can own SLA + rollout telemetry. quick question: what percentile and latency floor are we targeting as a gating criterion? staging numbers are p95=220ms, p99=420ms for typical traces.

zoe: ops items i need: oncall rota filled for first 72h, automated smoke that runs post-deploy (canary + region check), capacity reservation plan (how many reserved GPUs?), and a rollback playbook. also need SLOs mapped to pager thresholds.

sami: docs owner here. i'll produce two artifacts: (1) internal runbook with debugging checklist & sample queries, (2) customer-facing FAQ + pricing blurb. need a sample set of failure scenarios from eng to illustrate repro steps.

finance-team: need pricing proposal by wed EOD. we need an example tier (pilot pricing), delta vs existing hosted API, and a short migration note for billed customers. also confirm whether metering (tokens vs requests) changes.

arjun: propose these gating numbers for discussion: p95 latency < 400ms, error rate < 0.5% over 1h, cold-start tail p99 < 1.2s. if any metric spikes during the canary we fail forward to fallback model.

zoe: agree on thresholds as a starting point. for alarms map: p95 breach -> slack alert (prod-alerts), p99 breach or error_rate spike -> page to oncall. can we codify thresholds in monitoring config?

arjun: yes — will add to prometheus/alerting rule. snippet:```yaml
groups:
  - name: realtime_api.rules
    rules:
      - alert: RealtimeAPIP95High
        expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.4
        for: 5m
      - alert: RealtimeAPIErrorRate
        expr: increase(request_errors_total[5m]) / increase(request_total[5m]) > 0.005
        for: 5m
```

maria: perfect — add the exact alert names to the runbook so SRE has playbook links. also we need a short smoke test matrix (success criteria) that ops can run automatically.

zoe: smoke matrix (ops):
- basic token auth + 3 example prompts
- streaming path test (long response)
- KV cache hit check (cold vs warmed)
- billing metered sample request
if all green -> promote canary to 10% traffic.

sami: i'll include those tests in docs and link curl snippets to the internal runbook. example snippet i'll add to public FAQ:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/realtime -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

finance-team: on billing: confirm whether the pilot uses current hosted rate card or a temporary pilot price. prefer pilot price with note: "billed at X% discount for N months" and explicit upgrade path. provide the microsample numbers and i can draft the PR to pricing.

maria: decision tree: pilot customers -> pilot pricing (finance to draft), general customers -> existing tiers unless we cut a new dedicated SKU. owners: SLA/telemetry=arjun, ops runbook+smoke=zoe, docs= sami, pricing=finance-team.

ops-bot: Deployment window claimed by @zoe for Thu 09:00-11:00 UTC — automated canary enabled.

arjun: one more ask: we need a short list of customer-facing support playbooks for tiered support (pilot vs paid). minimal: triage steps, expected response times, and escalation path. can product/ops agree on response SLAs?

maria: suggested response SLAs for pilot: 24h initial ack, 72h workaround or rollback. paid customers follow SLA doc (1h/4h/24h tiers). is everyone okay with that?

zoe: ok for pilot ack 24h but ops needs guaranteed rota night coverage for paid-tier. we'll staff accordingly for paid customers.

sami: i'll draft KB + email templates for pilot vs paid support and link them in the runbook. plan to have drafts by Wed lunchtime.

maria: thanks — action items: arjun add alert rules + example dashboards (owner), zoe finalize smoke + rota (owner), sami docs + KB (owner), finance finalize pilot pricing (owner). target: all artifacts in a single PR to the product repo by Thu 18:00 UTC. if we hit that, we do the production clearance handshake meeting Fri morning. anyone blocked?

arjun: blocked on a minor model perf tweak — pushing a small quantization patch today, will validate against canary metrics.

finance-team: blocked on one question: does metering change to per-response or remain per-token? pinging billing infra for confirmation.

maria: noted. i'll follow up on billing infra and loop you in. thanks everyone — short sync tomorrow 10:00 to check progress. :thumbsup:
